source_spec: anchored interneuron share (SCI, 2026-11-17); arms 91 to 94 of pilot_bisect_anchor_model.py

predictions.statement: S-HT crossing of rel_bursts above 1.5, smallest first: arm 94 < arm 93 < arm 92 < arm 91 (a not-in-bracket crossing counts as +infinity)
central anchored arm (KO interneuron:pyramid ratio 2.6, proportional coupling): S-HT crossing between 0.3 and 0.7, i.e. the miss of P3a STAYS (below my original lower bound 0.7)
arm 92 (equal fractional block, coupling 2): S-HT crossing between 0.5 and 1.2, inside or next to my original range
arm 91 (equal fractional block, proportional coupling): S-HT crossing above 1.0 or not within the bracket
arm 94 at S-KO: rel_bursts stays above 0.7 for s <= 1
S-KO crossing below 0.7: arm 91 earlier than arm 94 (less interneuron offset)

caveats: weights not concentrations; 40 slices per batch; S-HT baseline has few bursts (about 10 per 40 slices), so rel_bursts at S-HT is noisy: read it with the incidence_baseline and incidence_arm fields; the settings S-HT phasic position 0.9 is assumed.
translation_note: SCI wrote these mechanical predictions directly (no translation); estimate = midpoint of the final bracket; statistic = median over 5 seeds; S-HT noisy (about 10 bursts per 40 slices)
